material_contracts: FileBlock allocation is 1Ch=28 bytes; older FILE_BLOCK_SETUP.md says28h incorrectly. Real +0 profileD68494, +4 refcount1, +8/+C/+10 zero, owning name+14/+18.
Preparation uses source job name substring(start13,count=storedLength-18), passes flag1; stores EAX to job+20 before releasing temporary. No prefix/minimum-length validation or fallback object.
Retirement captures current job FileBlock, current slot+4 target, passes1 and clears job+20 only after successful return. Scalar destructor itself does not decrement refs.

Constructor and destructor each reload CURRENT0109CEEC at their own VFS call; entry/exit retain their captured receiver across observer dispatch. Observer bodies separately reload current publication at every visible manager call.

Entry links saved gate node and ANDs gate before observer, then depth increment/name copy. Exit observer runs first, then clear name/decrement depth, restore saved gate and erase node. Exit never restores previous name.
Actual VFS construction/destruction already owns +7Ch list/head; do not create a sidecar gate stack or typed VfsProviderManager projection.
Runtime+88 is actual PakRegistry profileD64190. Slots+8/+C are missing BB5770/BB5910 mount/unmount operations, not optional tracing no-ops.

BB5670 uses first case-sensitive strstr(.mpak) occurrence and compares its position with storedLength-5; an earlier occurrence causes append even when a later suffix matches. Result/source identity branch follows native stores.

BB5770 temporarily clears current manager+20, resolves mutable name and on success selects device, increments captured registry ordinal, mounts under dot, appends returned raw provider (even null on returning failure path), then increments current manager+1C/sets+20. Finish recomputes current+20 from signed+1C.

BB5910 ignores resolution Boolean, removes all matching registry vector entries without releasing them, unmounts once under dot, and decrements current manager+1C/registry ordinal only on unmount success. Finish recomputes current+20.
BE0750 uses first matching actual mount-tree node; decrements captured provider refcount and dispatches current virtual0 at zero before erasing node. Existing tree erase owns node/key, not provider.

Stable acquired preparation/observer frames must own actual allocations and native mutable locals borrowed by nested BDF4C0 acquired frames. Unknown provider boundaries must retain outer state or terminate before unwind; successful native-EH cleanup may only run when its boundary is modeled.
BB5670 length4/no .mpak match leaves the input unchanged because both the not-found position and length-5 equal FFFFFFFF; preserve 32-bit comparison rather than replacing it with ends_with.
